tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN into official NHTSA VPIC specs and every open recall — for US-market vehicles (any car sold or titled in the United States; commonly used worldwide to verify US-sourced and imported used cars). Powered by CheckMyVIN — the free VIN decoder at https://checkmyvin.net. Each cal

tools.name: check_recalls
tools.description: Look up open NHTSA safety recalls for a vehicle by make, model, and model year. Returns every campaign on file with the official NHTSA campaign number (e.g. 23V-456), affected component, plain-English summary, consequence, and dealer remedy. Use when the user asks about recalls without providing a V

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "decode_vin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
